Split this into separate comparisons: Zhengzhang Old Chinese 昜 `laŋ` vs 場 `l'aŋ` (cite X-d95c5280b673f50549c6 and X-88dd0bc2852ed66c930a), and Middle Chinese 昜 `yang` vs 場 `drjang` (cite X-88dd0bc2852ed66c930a and X-d95c5280b673f50549c6). Explain that the Middle Chinese forms share rhyme and syllable shape but differ in initial; do not label the rhyme-dictionary categories as Baxter transcriptions.
